higher-lower.title: Higher or Lower
higher-lower.desc: Guess whether the next card is higher or lower.

kings-cup.title: King's Cup
kings-cup.desc: Draw a card, follow its rule, and don't pull the last King.

ride-the-bus.title: Ride the Bus
ride-the-bus.desc: Guess four cards in a row or ride the bus.

mexico.title: Mexico
mexico.desc: Roll two dice; the lowest score drinks.

liars-dice.title: Liar's Dice
liars-dice.desc: Bid on hidden dice and call out the liar.

ship-captain-crew.title: Ship, Captain, Crew
ship-captain-crew.desc: Roll a 6-5-4, then score with your crew.

beer-pong.title: Beer Pong
beer-pong.desc: Sink the ball in the other team's cups.

flip-cup.title: Flip Cup
flip-cup.desc: Drink, then flip your cup. Fastest team wins.

quarters.title: Quarters
quarters.desc: Bounce a coin into the glass.

spin-the-bottle.title: Spin the Bottle
spin-the-bottle.desc: Spin the bottle; whoever it points at is up.

truth-or-dare.title: Truth or Dare
truth-or-dare.desc: Pick truth or dare. Chicken out and you drink.

never-have-i-ever.title: Never Have I Ever
never-have-i-ever.desc: Drink if you've done it. No lying!

most-likely-to.title: Most Likely To
most-likely-to.desc: Point at whoever is most likely to do it.

hl.penalty_help: With streak, your current streak is added to the sips.

card.title: Name
card.sips_help: Base sips, adjusted by your intensity settings.

mx.maxRolls_help: Stop early whenever you like. Your last roll is your score.
mx.leaderSetsRolls: First player sets the roll limit
mx.leaderSetsRolls_help: However many rolls the first player uses becomes everyone else's limit that round.
mx.mexicoDoubles_help: Every Mexico (2-1) rolled in a round doubles what the loser drinks.
mx.tie_help: Roll-off: only the tied players roll again until one of them loses.

scc.maxRolls_help: Lock a 6 (ship), then a 5 (captain), then a 4 (crew). The other two dice are your cargo.
scc.winnerGivesSips_help: 0 = off. The top scorer gives these sips to anyone they like.

ld.onesWild_help: 1s count as any face, except when the bid is on 1s.
ld.spotOn_help: Call it when you think the bid is exactly right. Right: everyone else drinks. Wrong: you drink.
ld.loseDie_help: Run out of dice and you're out. Last one with dice wins. Off: play until the host ends it.

stb.outcome_help: With 'The table decides', the app just shows who got picked. What happens next is up to you.
stb.sips_help: For whoever gets picked in Drink mode. Refusing a truth or dare costs one more.
stb.allowSelf: Bottle can land on the spinner
stb.allowSelf_help: When off, the bottle never lands on whoever spun it.

tod.choice_help: With the wheel, a spin decides truth or dare for you.
tod.refuseSips_help: Base sips. A prompt can set its own amount.
tod.rounds_help: 0 = keep going until the host ends it.

mlt.voting_help: Point: everyone points at once and the reader records it. Secret: pass the phone, vote one by one, and the results come out at the end.

rtb.wrongSips_help: Escalating: you drink the question number.
rtb.pyramid_help: Ten face-down cards. Match one and you hand out sips. Whoever ends up holding the most cards rides the bus.
rtb.busMaxAttempts_help: After this many tries the rider gets off anyway. Enough is enough!

notice.safe: {{streak}} in a row! You're safe, pass it on.

A.title: Waterfall
A.text: Everyone drinks, starting with you. Nobody stops until the person before them stops.

4.title: Floor
4.text: Touch the floor! Last one to do it drinks.

5.title: Thumb Master
5.text: You're the Thumb Master. Put your thumb on the table any time and everyone must copy. Last one drinks.

7.title: Heaven
7.text: Point to the sky! Last one to do it drinks.

8.title: Mate
8.text: Pick a mate. Whenever one of you drinks, the other drinks too.

9.title: Rhyme
9.text: Say a word. Go around the table rhyming with it. First to stall or repeat drinks.

10.title: Categories
10.text: Pick a category, like beer brands. Go around naming things in it. First to blank drinks.

J.title: Make a Rule
J.text: Make a new house rule. Anyone who breaks it drinks.

Q.title: Question Master
Q.text: You're the Question Master. Anyone who answers one of your questions drinks.

K.title: King's Cup
K.text: Pour some of your drink into the King's Cup. Whoever draws the 4th King drinks the cup!
